name: PersonalRecommendations
description: Builds a per-user taste profile from previously watched movies and series (genres, cast, crew, studios) and maintains a private "Recommended For You" playlist for each user, kept up to date on a schedule and after playback.
overview: Personalized recommendations based on watch history
changelog: 0.2.0: Switched from collections to playlists for delivering recommendations — Jellyfin collections ignore per-user visibility, so they were showing up for every user instead of staying private. Playlists have a real owner and are private by default; recommended series are represented by their next unwatched episode so a series doesn't get expanded into every episode. 0.1.0: Initial release.
